ktk.text: The Mardu were a warrior horde of Tarkir led by the khan Zurgo, and in the original timeline Kolaghan's brood lost to the clans after Ugin's death, with Kolaghan's skull becoming the Mardu khan's throne.
Zurgo mobilized the horde to hunt Sarkhan in Temur lands and suffered heavy losses, as a blizzard and Temur ambush killed a hundred Mardu in the mountains.
Varuk then told Zurgo the clan no longer followed him and led the horde back to Wingthrone, abandoning Zurgo.
In the new timeline, the Mardu took a different path, as Alesha abolished the Mardu in the Khanfall following Kolaghan's invitation.

frf.text: A Mardu hordechief feasted on loot and planned the next raid while privately hiding his own self-doubt, and he ordered an immediate attack on an Abzan patrol that had found a shepherds' camp the horde had destroyed.
The Mardu horde split in two to attack both ends of the canyon, where an Abzan siege elephant tower rose before the hordechief.

Elsewhere, Zurgo rallied the horde after defeating a Temur force, but Temur raiders then struck the center of the Mardu line and killed over a hundred Mardu, and Varuk declared that the horde feared Zurgo rather than served him.
In another telling, Alesha led the Mardu horde in an ambush of six dragons from Kolaghan's brood, and all six dragons died at great cost.
